## What landed

**Emit.** `exports/downloads.py` — slice emission (`by-source/<id>/` —
sites.csv.gz when the source has site rows, `statements.jsonl.gz` always,
`ATTRIBUTION.txt`/`LICENCE.txt`), GNU `SHA256SUMS`, `write_integrity_files`,
`verify_downloads` (`sig.download-verify/1`, states signed/unsigned/
incomplete — tamper, missing member, malformed sums all loud), and
`download_listing` (the `sig.download-listing/1` doc over the manifest:
files with licence/format/size/row-count/sha256/R2 href; groups per
compartment, per-source slice, release+integrity, transparency; counts;
mirror + signature blocks). `exports/minisign.py` — pure-Python Ed25519
(RFC 8032) + the byte-compatible minisign container (public key, secret
payload parse, detached signature with trusted-comment global sig);
`generate_keypair`/`sign_detached`/`verify_detached`/`public_key_for_secret`;
`SIG_RELEASE_MINISIGN_SECRET` env contract. `spine_export.py` — the slice +
txt emissions ride the same compartment-attribution payload;
`web/downloads.json` emitted last inside `_extended_manifest` (a manifest
member itself, dictionary-documented, `by-source/` documented as a
pattern); `build_spine_export`/`run_spine_export` gain `download_signing`
(+`mirror_registry_path`); `SpineExport.write_to` gains
`signing_secret_b64`. `release.py` — `releases/<pub>/data/` gains
`download_listing.json` (pub-bound), the T0 `index.html`
(`downloads_listing_page` in `release_pages.py`) and bound integrity
copies; `data`/`data/api`/`data/dictionary` join `EXTERNAL_LINK_ROUTES`.
`cli.py` — `sig-exports downloads verify --in <dir>` (exit 0 signed /
4 unsigned-valid / 3 failure); `sig-exports build` reads
`SIG_RELEASE_MINISIGN_SECRET` → signed emit. `push.py` — the mirror push
carries `manifest.json`/`SHA256SUMS`/`SHA256SUMS.minisig`/
`sig-release.minisign.pub` at content-hash keys (mirrors.toml `carries`).

**Web.** `web/src/lib/downloads.ts` (`sig.download-listing/1` contract +
fail-closed guard) + `downloads-fixture.ts` (honest interim posture:
mirror committed-disabled, `unsigned` declared) + `data.ts`
`getDownloadListing()` (export-mode reads `<export>/web/downloads.json`
fail-loud). `/data/` — the downloads center: latest-release label + cite
the fixed URL; mirror posture; integrity/verify block; per-group tables
(file, format, licence, size, rows, sha256); linked metadata. `/data/api/`
— JSON twins, release-pinned routes, terms + numeric rate limits,
equivalent-request convention. `page-types.ts` — the two T1 rows + the
T0 row re-owned to P36.50. Copy `data-copy` ids DL-01…07 + AP-01…04.

**Records.** `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-11.md` — 11 pending
rows. `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — `D-P36.50-1` (OP-20 key + first
signed-release verify leg). `docs/build/COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` — the
P36.50-owned TRANSP/LIC/REL rows' coverage cells.
